english.title: Pilot fail to be satisfied before take-off that aircraft carried equipment necessary for facilitating survival
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the pilot in command of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), failed to be satisfied on reasonable grounds before take-off that the aircraft carried such additional equipment as you reasonably considered necessary for the purposes of facilitating the survival of the persons carried in the aircraft
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 72(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
